preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: 1 in set(x for x, y in edges) or 1 in set(y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Vertex 1 is connected to at least one other vertex.

postconditions.description: The minimal time required for all ants to be in the root of the tree is at least 1 second.

postconditions.expression: t == max(max(bfs_distance(leaf, 1) for leaf in leaves), default=0)
postconditions.description: The minimal time required for all ants to be in the root of the tree is the maximum distance from any leaf to the root.
